title: Amgen (AMGN) Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Defensive healthcare alongside a Bitcoin breakout.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: Full payroll recovery in July 2022 supports the drawn-out second stage. The 420000-per-month figure is arithmetic conditional on a two-year target, not a forecast that precisely that many jobs would arrive.

evidence.title: July 2022 Employment Situation release
evidence.finding: The release reported payroll employment and unemployment rate had returned to February 2020 levels in July 2022. This is a publication-vintage recovery date, not a claim about subsequently revised payroll history.

claims.reason: Hospital capacity can affect restrictions and voluntary behavior, but no causal design separates those channels. Hospitalizations and deaths also depend on age, treatment and reporting, so they are not perfectly stable infection measures.

evidence.title: HFCAA implementation
evidence.finding: The original 2020 law used three consecutive identification years; 2022 amendments shortened this to two. Prohibitions cover national exchanges and OTC trading for covered issuers, not just delisting.

evidence.title: Complete China/Hong Kong inspection access
evidence.finding: PCAOB secured complete inspection/investigation access in 2022 and vacated prior contrary determinations, removing the then-immediate trigger toward HFCAA prohibitions.

claims.reason: Profitable operations may not need new US funding, but liquidity, financing cost, governance signals and investor eligibility still affect value. A forced-access loss is not automatically a buying opportunity for an affected investor.

claims.reason: HFCAA prohibitions can cover OTC trading, so OTC location alone is no blanket exemption. Tencent's reporting/issuer status must be examined separately before claiming it faces exactly the same restriction as listed BABA or JD.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.finding: 2025 total revenue 36.8 bn dollars, 10% above 2024; portfolio growth coexisted with generic competition in some products. Continuing product development and acquisitions affected the business mix.

evidence.finding: December 27, 2020 legislation extended the CDC eviction order through January 31, 2021. The original end-December expiration therefore did not produce an immediate nationwide lapse.

framework_lessons: Regulatory procedure can overturn valuation assumptions.
assessment: Bitcoin's threshold call succeeded quickly. The defensive Amgen idea generated positive long-window returns but lagged the index, while the claimed political barrier to drug reform failed. Chinese-listing discussion correctly avoided assuming immediate removal, yet OTC trading and issuer eligibility need more careful separation.
